options.blogdescription: Helping animals find their forever homes

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// --- Settings ---
$s = get_option('smartpay_settings', []);
$s['default_gateway'] = 'manual';
$s['gateways'] = ['manual' => 1];
$s['currency'] = 'USD';
$s['currency_position'] = 'before';
$s['decimal_separator'] = '.';
$s['thousands_separator'] = ',';
update_option('smartpay_settings', $s, false);

// --- Form ---
$content = '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name {"showMiddleName":false} -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-field {"sub":"first"} -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-label /-->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-input /-->
<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/name-field -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-field {"sub":"last"} -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-label /-->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-input /-->
<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/name-field -->
<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/name -->

<!-- wp:smartpay-form/email -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/email-label /-->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/email-input /-->
<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/email -->

<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing {"allowCustomAmount":true,"customAmountLabel":"Enter your gift amount"} -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing-option {"key":"feed","label":"Feed a pet for a week","description":"Covers food for one shelter animal","amount":"10","billing_type":"One Time"} /-->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing-option {"key":"rescue","label":"Sponsor a rescue","description":"Helps cover transport and initial care","amount":"25","billing_type":"One Time"} /-->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing-option {"key":"medical","label":"Fund a medical check","description":"Covers a full vet examination","amount":"50","billing_type":"One Time"} /-->
<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/pricing -->

<!-- wp:smartpay-form/submit-button -->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/submit-coupon /-->
<!-- wp:smartpay-form/submit-pay /-->
<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/submit-button -->';

$form_id = wp_insert_post([
    'post_title'   => 'Help Happy Paws Animal Rescue',
    'post_content' => $content,
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_type'    => 'smartpay_form',
]);

if ($form_id && !is_wp_error($form_id)) {
    update_post_meta($form_id, '_smartpay_amounts', json_encode([
        ['key'=>'feed',   'label'=>'Feed a pet for a week',  'description'=>'Covers food for one shelter animal',      'amount'=>10, 'billing_type'=>'One Time'],
        ['key'=>'rescue', 'label'=>'Sponsor a rescue',       'description'=>'Helps cover transport and initial care',  'amount'=>25, 'billing_type'=>'One Time'],
        ['key'=>'medical','label'=>'Fund a medical check',   'description'=>'Covers a full vet examination',           'amount'=>50, 'billing_type'=>'One Time'],
    ]));
}

// --- Donate Now page ---
$fid = $form_id ?: 1;
wp_insert_post([
    'post_title'   => 'Donate Now',
    'post_name'    => 'donate-now',
    'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->[smartpay_form id="' . $fid . '"]<!-- /wp:shortcode -->',
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_type'    => 'page',
]);

// --- Seed donations ---
global $wpdb;
$table_p = $wpdb->prefix . 'smartpay_payments';
$table_c = $wpdb->prefix . 'smartpay_customers';

$donors = [
    ['Sarah',  'Mitchell', 'sarah@example.com',  25,  'rescue',  'Sponsor a rescue'],
    ['James',  'Okafor',   'james@example.com',  50,  'medical', 'Fund a medical check'],
    ['Emily',  'Chen',     'emily@example.com',  10,  'feed',    'Feed a pet for a week'],
    ['Marcus', 'Williams', 'marcus@example.com', 25,  'rescue',  'Sponsor a rescue'],
    ['Aisha',  'Patel',    'aisha@example.com',  100, 'custom',  'Custom donation'],
];

foreach ($donors as $i => $d) {
    $existing = $wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare("SELECT id FROM {$table_c} WHERE email=%s", $d[2]));
    if (!$existing) {
        $wpdb->insert($table_c, ['first_name'=>$d[0],'last_name'=>$d[1],'email'=>$d[2]]);
        $cid = $wpdb->insert_id;
    } else {
        $cid = $existing;
    }
    $wpdb->insert($table_p, [
        'type'           => 'form_payment',
        'data'           => json_encode(['form_id'=>$fid,'key'=>$d[4],'label'=>$d[5]]),
        'amount'         => $d[3],
        'currency'       => 'USD',
        'gateway'        => 'manual',
        'transaction_id' => 'DEMO-' . strtoupper(substr(md5($d[2] . $i), 0, 8)),
        'customer_id'    => $cid,
        'email'          => $d[2],
        'key'            => md5($d[2] . $i . time()),
        'mode'           => 'Live',
        'status'         => 'completed',
        'completed_at'   => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime('-' . (($i + 1) * 3) . ' days')),
    ]);
}

echo 'Setup complete. Form ID: ' . $fid;
